name: Per-Fragment Phong Lighting with Gradient Normals
definition: Volume shading enabled by the user, based on per-fragment Phong lighting where normal vectors are derived from the gradient of the scalar field.
summary: Per-Fragment Phong Lighting with Gradient Normals enhances volume rendering realism by estimating surface normals from scalar field gradients for standard Phong shading, unlike methods that modulate alpha for silhouette enhancement.
